evals.prompt: I just cloned the video-search-and-summarization sample app and want to try video summarization. Can you spin up VSS in summary mode with the default settings and tell me the URL to open once it's ready?
evals.expected_output: Runs the VSS deploy flow for summary mode from the resolved app root: generates/reuses runtime secrets, sources config and secrets, stops any stale stack, sources setup.sh with --summary, waits for manager health, and reports the summary UI URL on the nginx gateway.
expectations: The answer uses the bundled bootstrap helper to resolve APP_ROOT and changes directory into the VSS app root before deployment commands.
The answer generates or reuses vss.secrets.env with .github/skills/vss-deploy/scripts/gen-secrets.sh and sources both vss.config.env and vss.secrets.env.
The answer runs source setup.sh --stop before source setup.sh --summary so stale or wrong-mode containers cannot collide.
The answer sources setup.sh rather than executing ./setup.sh directly.
The answer waits for health with scripts/wait-health.sh and reports the summary UI URL as http://<host-ip>:12345/ or using APP_HOST_PORT.

evals.prompt: Before I commit to anything, I want to see which Docker Compose files and profiles would be used if I ran VSS in dual UI mode (both summary and search with separate UIs), without actually starting any containers. Can you show me that?
evals.expected_output: Performs a config-only inspection for Dual UI mode without starting containers, showing the compose overlays/profiles that setup.sh would use and explaining the resulting dual UI paths.
expectations: The answer uses source setup.sh --summary --search config or the equivalent --dual config for the dry-run.
The answer makes clear that config mode renders docker compose config rather than running up -d or starting containers.
The answer identifies the Dual UI compose overlays as docker/compose.base.yaml, docker/compose.summary.yaml, docker/compose.search.yaml, and docker/compose.ui.yaml.
The answer identifies the Dual UI profiles as ovms and dual_ui.
The answer mentions the Dual UI paths /summary/ and /search/ on the nginx gateway host port 12345.

evals.prompt: VSS is currently running in --summary mode but I actually need to test search instead. Please switch it over to search mode for me — do I need to stop it first, and will my MULTIMODAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL setting carry over?
evals.expected_output: Switches an existing summary deployment to search mode by stopping the old stack, ensuring search configuration and secrets are loaded, starting setup.sh with --search, waiting for health, and explaining that MULTIMODAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL must be present from config or the shell.
expectations: The answer includes source setup.sh --stop or source setup.sh --down before starting search mode.
The answer starts search mode with source setup.sh --search.

The answer states that MULTIMODAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL is required for Search mode and must be exported or sourced from vss.config.env; it does not magically carry over unless present in the environment/config.
The answer mentions search mode uses docker/compose.search.yaml with the singleton search UI on http://<host-ip>:12345/.
The answer waits for health through the nginx gateway using scripts/wait-health.sh or the /manager/health route.

evals.prompt: I'm done testing VSS for today. Please stop all the containers and also wipe the Postgres, MinIO, and VDMS data volumes so my next deployment starts completely fresh.
evals.expected_output: Explains the teardown commands that must be sourced, distinguishes stopping/removing containers from full data cleanup, notes that these teardown commands bypass normal deployment env validation, and lists the concrete volumes or artifacts removed by `--clean-data`.
expectations: The answer includes `source setup.sh --stop` and/or its alias `source setup.sh --down` as the command to stop and remove containers.
The answer includes `source setup.sh --clean-data` as the full reset command.
The answer states that `--stop`, `--clean-data`, or config-only inspection skip the normal required-environment validation.

The answer lists at least three exact cleanup targets from `docker_minio_data`, `docker_pg_data`, `docker_vdms-db`, `docker_audio_analyzer_data`, `docker_data-prep`, `docker_collector_signals`, or `.ov_venv`.
The answer distinguishes that `--stop` removes containers across VSS overlays/profiles, while `--clean-data` additionally removes persisted volumes/data.

evals.prompt: Deploy VSS in unified mode (one UI where I can search over the generated summaries) on host port 18080 instead of the default 12345. Also, I want to keep running manual docker compose commands myself afterward, so leave the resolved environment variables in my shell instead of just running everything for me.
evals.expected_output: Deploys Unified UI mode on APP_HOST_PORT=18080, distinguishes normal deployment that the agent can run in a subshell from --setenv which the user must source in their own shell, waits for health on the custom port, and reports the unified UI URL.
expectations: The answer uses APP_HOST_PORT=18080 with source setup.sh --summary-and-search or an equivalent unified alias for the deployment.
The answer states that --setenv is the exception that must be run by the user in their interactive shell because a subshell cannot persist exported variables back to that shell.
The answer provides the user-facing setenv command APP_HOST_PORT=18080 source setup.sh --setenv --summary-and-search or an equivalent unified alias.
The answer reports the Unified UI URL as http://<host-ip>:18080/.

The answer mentions Unified UI behavior grounded in the skill, such as search over summaries, TEXT_EMBEDDING_MODEL/EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME, VS_INDEX_NAME=video_summary_embeddings, or APP_FEATURE_MUX=SUMMARY_SEARCH.

evals.prompt: Deploy VSS in summary mode using the defaults, then once it's healthy tell me the UI URL and confirm which containers came up.
evals.expected_output: Before touching setup.sh, the answer unconditionally runs the bundled scripts/vss-bootstrap.sh to resolve the VSS app root, checking the enclosing git repo's remote (origin/upstream) to see if it already traces back to the official open-edge-platform/edge-ai-libraries repo (or a fork of it) and reusing that checkout if so, or otherwise performing a shallow single-branch sparse checkout of sample-applications/video-search-and-summarization from main, then cd's into the resolved app root before deploying in summary mode and reporting the UI URL and running containers.
expectations: The answer runs the bundled bootstrap helper (scripts/vss-bootstrap.sh) as a first step before doing the requested summary-mode deployment, even though the prompt never asked about setup, location, or cloning.

The bootstrap check determines whether the current location is already a valid clone/checkout (or a fork) of the VSS project by inspecting the enclosing git repository's remote configuration (e.g., git remote -v / origin or upstream URL) to see if it points at the official open-edge-platform/edge-ai-libraries repo or a fork of it, rather than relying on local marker files alone.
If that check finds a valid existing checkout (the user's own clone, or a fork whose remote traces back to the official repo), the answer states that checkout is reused and NO re-clone is performed.
If no valid checkout or matching remote is found, the answer performs a shallow, single-branch sparse checkout of only sample-applications/video-search-and-summarization from main.
The answer changes directory into the resolved app root (cd "$APP_ROOT") before running the skill's real setup.sh/deployment commands for the requested task.
